name: RRSOS PCC Boosters
description: A Boosters screen in the build menu (1 Iron, 1 Aluminium, 1 Alloy). Using it opens a window where you pick a named beacon, a booster (heat, pressure, butterflies, bees, ecosystem, frogs, trees, grass, flowers), the machine tier, an optimizer and its fuses, and what to fill the machines with; Build places eight machines and the optimizers at the beacon for free and takes the beacon away.
